name: confirm-dialog
summary: A centered question that asks the person to confirm an action before it runs, with Cancel focused first.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Names the panel for assistive technology and shows at its top. Always required; hideTitle hides it visually.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A short line under the title, read out when the panel opens.

properties.name: confirmLabel
properties.description: The confirm button's label: the action, never OK.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: The confirm button's colour role; destructive for what can't be undone.

properties.name: action
properties.description: The Ouro AX action this confirms. When set, the description is actionText(action).confirm, the same words the consent sheet and an agent's confirm prompt use.

events.name: close
events.description: Cancel or Escape; an outside press never closes it.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Cancel and the confirm button scale to the press scale, never under reduced motion.

states.name: busy
states.description: The confirmed action is running: the confirm button keeps its width and can't be pressed again; Cancel still closes.

accessibility.name: Its title.
accessibility.keyboard: Focus starts on Cancel; Escape cancels; Enter on the confirm button confirms.
accessibility.web: A role="alertdialog" named by its title and described by its description.
accessibility.apple: A confirmation dialog with a cancel role button and, for destructive, the destructive role.
accessibility.windows: A ContentDialog with Cancel as the default button: UI Automation ControlType.Window named by the title.
accessibility.android: A Compose AlertDialog: a node with a pane title from the title, a heading for it, and Cancel and confirm buttons, Cancel focused.

cases.person: A centered question with Cancel and a red Delete button.
The question reads the action's own confirm text, as its consent sheet does.

children.name: Share your list with this person? They will be able to see it and change it.

deviations: onConfirm may return a promise, which keeps the dialog open and busy until it settles.
